messages:
Sara (CS): Hey team — LumenPay escalated. After last night's rollout (v2.3.1 default), their invoice-summary generator is omitting invoice_id lines for ~4% of requests. Customer sent examples.

Lucia (Eng): Ack. Can you paste a minimal input + output and the model key they hit? Also which rollout id?

Sara (CS): Rollout id: rollout_2026_03_15_v2.3.1. Model: redwood/longjs-v2-3-q4
Example request (customer redacted):
```json
{"customer_id":"<redacted>","invoices":[{"date":"2026-03-01","total":123.45,"invoice_id":"INV-1001"}]}
```
Customer output:
```
Summary for March: total $123.45. Items: 1 invoice.
```
Missing invoice_id line.

Devin (ML): Hm. Can you attach the prompt logs (input tokens + system prompt) and the exact API call? Need model, temperature, max_tokens, and any post-processing.

Sara (CS): Requested prompt logs — customer gave full prompt logs but asks us to mask PII before storing. I uploaded a redacted snippet to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/ISSUE-4567 and attached prompt logs id: pl_987654321

Lucia (Eng): Thanks. @Devin can you run a minimal repro locally? Try the same prompt with deterministic settings (temp=0, top_p=1, max_new_tokens=128) and enable kv-cache debug. Also test with pre-rollout model v2.2.x.

Devin (ML): On it. Quick repro curl I used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood/longjs-v2-3-q4","input":"<redacted prompt>","temperature":0,"max_new_tokens":128}'
```
Reproduced omission once in ~25 runs with the customer's input. Switching to v2.2.9 yields no omissions in 200 runs.

Aj (PM): Risk assessment — is this regression severity-high? Customer says it breaks their reconciliation flow. We should offer a rollback or targeted fallback.

Lucia (Eng): If it's 4% and impacts key field, treat as high. Options: 1) rollback rollout_2026_03_15_v2.3.1 for LumenPay tenant, 2) add a deterministic post-check in gateway that re-queries for missing invoice_id, or 3) hotfix model config to bias for explicit field.

Sara (CS): Customer asked for ETA. Can we propose temporary mitigation now?

Devin (ML): I'll open an infra experiment: run on v2.3.1 with forced decode bias toward 'invoice_id' token sequences and see effect. If we can validate, we can patch quickly. Otherwise recommend per-tenant rollback.

triage-bot: [run_created] triage-run-6421 by Devin (ML) — results pending

Aj (PM): Sara, offer to rollback for LumenPay and request permission to run forced-bias experiment. Also ask customer for 3-5 more minimal examples where omission happened and the request ids (if they have them).

Sara (CS): Sent to customer: "We can rollback or test a quick config patch. Please share 3 more examples and any request ids; if you want rollback, say 'rollback now'." :thumbsup: 

Lucia (Eng): Also remind CS to include the prompt logs export id (pl_987654321) and to confirm whether any custom post-processing runs on their side.

Sara (CS): Will confirm. Closing loop once we have more examples or rollback approval. :eyes:
